municipality-vancouver.label: Vancouver: City emblem, colour
municipality-vancouver.sourceLocator: Visual Standards Guide, PDF page 5: the colour emblem. Region recorded in the extraction recipe.
municipality-vancouver.dateNote: February 2018 is the guide’s date, not an adoption date.
municipality-vancouver.notes: The City emblem in colour, for white or very light grounds: two overlapping blue and green forms over “CITY OF VANCOUVER”. The guide reads them as budding blossoms, ocean waves, mountain peaks, birds, the sails of Canada Place and a V for Vancouver.
municipality-vancouver.fidelityNote: The guide’s own 17 filled paths, in its own colours and geometry, as MuPDF converts the page. Only the mark’s paths are kept. No tracing, retyping, recolouring or redrawing.
municipality-vancouver.rightsNote: The guide states the emblem is the City’s property, protected by copyright and trademark, and that use needs the City’s authorization. No permission to reproduce it here has been sought.

adoption.label: 18 July 2006
adoption.note: The guide records that the emblem was designed by the City’s in-house graphic designer, Elaine Ayres, and adopted unanimously by Council on 18 July 2006.

vancouver-arms-guide-2018.label: Coat of arms
vancouver-arms-guide-2018.sourceLocator: Visual Standards Guide, PDF page 4: the small rendering of the coat of arms, with “CITY OF VANCOUVER” beneath it, beside the arms text. Region recorded in the extraction recipe.
vancouver-arms-guide-2018.dateNote: The guide records that the arms were granted by the College of Arms in London on 31 March 1969. February 2018 is the guide’s date.
vancouver-arms-guide-2018.notes: The City’s coat of arms as the guide prints it: the shield with ship’s sail and crown, the logger and fisherman supporters, the Kwakwaka’wakw pole and dogwood, and the motto, over “CITY OF VANCOUVER”. The guide reserves the arms for Mayor and Council and formal, ceremonial use.
